add_d2go_data_default_configs: add default D2Go data configuration nodes for datasets, mappers, augmentation ops, and test settings to a CfgNode
configure_train_test_categories: configure train and test category lists to filter COCO dataset classes when loading data
configure_coco_injection: configure COCO dataset injection with names, image directories, JSON files, and optional keypoint metadata
configure_dataset_mapper: configure the D2GoDatasetMapper with backfill size, retry count, and exception catching settings
configure_augmentation_ops: configure train and test augmentation operation lists with transform names and optional JSON arguments
